_about: Human-written words for each scam type, for ages 10 to 13 (squad) and 14 to 18 (crew). The news collector matches an official news item to a type, then uses these words. No AI writes advice. Edit these by hand. No em dashes. titleOnly: true means the keywords must be in the official title, because they are common words. The words for 10 to 13 always say "tell a parent, or another adult you trust".

squad.title: Fake "unpaid toll" texts
squad.summary: You might see these on a family phone. Texts say someone owes a road toll and must pay today. Most are fake.
squad.doThis: Don't tap the link. Tell a parent, or another adult you trust.

crew.title: Fake unpaid toll texts are going around
crew.summary: A text says you owe a toll and will be fined unless you pay now. Toll texts with a pay-now link are usually scams.
crew.doThis: Don't tap. Check on the toll company's real site, typed in yourself.

squad.title: Fake "your package is stuck" texts
squad.summary: You might see these on a family phone. Texts say a delivery failed and ask you to tap a link or pay a small fee.
squad.doThis: Don't tap the link. Tell a parent, or another adult you trust. They can check the real delivery app.

crew.title: Fake delivery texts with a small fee
crew.summary: A text says your package is held and asks for a small fee. The fee page steals card details.
crew.doThis: Track packages only in the real app or site you open yourself.

squad.title: "Easy money" job offers
squad.summary: Seen in DMs and games too. Messages offer lots of money for easy online tasks. Many are scams.
squad.doThis: Never pay to get a job, and never move money for someone. Tell a parent, or another adult you trust.

crew.title: Fake jobs and money mule offers
crew.summary: Offers of easy pay for simple tasks, or for moving money through your account, are scams and can get you in legal trouble.
crew.doThis: Never pay to work or move money for anyone. Tell a parent, or another adult you trust.

squad.title: Anyone asking for gift cards
squad.summary: Seen in games too, from fake staff. Scammers ask people to buy gift cards and send the numbers. Real companies never ask for that.
squad.doThis: Never send gift card numbers. Tell a parent, or another adult you trust.

crew.title: Gift card payment demands
crew.summary: Anyone who tells you to pay with gift cards is a scammer. The numbers work like cash and can't be taken back.
crew.doThis: Don't buy or send. Tell a parent, or another adult you trust.

squad.title: "Get rich with crypto" offers
squad.summary: Seen in DMs and videos. Offers promise fast money with crypto. Many are scams that take the money.
squad.doThis: Don't send money or crypto. Tell a parent, or another adult you trust.

crew.title: Crypto and investment scams
crew.summary: Fake investment groups and "friends" promise big returns, then the money is gone. Crypto sent can't be taken back.
crew.doThis: Never send crypto to someone you met online. Check with someone you trust first.

squad.title: Scammers pretending to be someone official
squad.summary: In games, it can be fake staff or a fake moderator. Scammers pretend to be the government, a bank or a company to scare people into paying.
squad.doThis: Don't reply and don't pay. Tell a parent, or another adult you trust.

crew.title: Fake calls from "the bank" or "the government"
crew.summary: Caller ID and emails can be faked. Scammers pretend to be officials to rush you into paying or sharing codes.
crew.doThis: Hang up. Call back on the number from the real website.

squad.title: Fake "your device has a virus" warnings
squad.summary: These can pop up while you play or watch videos. Scary screens say a device has a virus and to call a number. It is a trick.
squad.doThis: Close the whole tab or app. Never call the number. Tell a parent, or another adult you trust.

crew.title: Fake virus warnings and tech support
crew.summary: A warning says your device is infected and to call support or allow remote access. Real companies don't do this.
crew.doThis: Close it. Never let a stranger control your device.

squad.title: Fake shops and too-good deals
squad.summary: Seen in ads for sneakers, skins and game codes. Fake shops sell popular things for very low prices, then send nothing.
squad.doThis: Tell a parent, or another adult you trust, before buying from a shop you don't know.

crew.title: Fake shops and ticket sellers
crew.summary: Deals that are too good, sellers in DMs, and payment apps with no buyer protection are the warning signs.
crew.doThis: Pay with a protected method. Check the seller first.

crew.title: Warnings about photo threats
crew.summary: Officials warn about people who threaten to share private photos unless they are paid. It is never your fault.
crew.doThis: Don't pay. Keep the messages. Tell a parent, or another adult you trust. Use Take It Down.

crew.title: A law to take down private images fast
crew.summary: Under the Take It Down Act, apps must remove nude or sexual images, including AI fakes, within 48 hours of a request.
crew.doThis: Tell a parent, or another adult you trust. Under 18? Use Take It Down.

squad.title: AI fakes that look and sound real
squad.summary: Seen in videos of famous creators. Scammers use AI to fake voices, faces and videos of real people.
squad.doThis: Check the creator's real channel. Not sure? Tell a parent, or another adult you trust.

crew.title: AI voices and deepfakes in scams
crew.summary: AI can copy a voice or face. A call that sounds like family asking for money may be fake.
crew.doThis: Hang up and call them back. Ask for your family word.

squad.title: Scam texts and emails going around
squad.summary: You might see these on your phone or a family phone. Officials warn about fake texts and emails that try to get people to tap a link or pay.
squad.doThis: Don't tap links in surprise messages. Tell a parent, or another adult you trust.

crew.title: Scam texts and emails going around
crew.summary: Fake messages copy real companies and agencies to get you to tap a link, log in or pay.
crew.doThis: Don't tap. Go to the real site or app yourself to check.

squad.title: Scams aimed at gamers
squad.summary: Seen in games. Fake free currency, fake trades and cheats with viruses are common tricks.
squad.doThis: Nothing free comes from outside the game. Clicked one? Tell a parent, or another adult you trust.

crew.title: Scams aimed at gamers
crew.summary: Free currency sites, cheap accounts and cracked games are used to steal logins and money.
crew.doThis: Only download from official stores. Never log in through a link.
